title: Edit an environment variable from the tooltip on the request URL
steps: Hover the <<site>> placeholder to display its environment values and edit icon.
Move the pointer from the placeholder toward the popup's edit icon.

video_guide.summary: Watch the site variable tooltip as the pointer approaches its edit icon. The popup disappears before the editor can be opened.

chapters.note: The request URL contains the site placeholder and Website Variables is selected.
The variable tooltip is visible with its values and edit icon.
The variable tooltip is absent and no edit dialog is visible.
